response.sql: WITH circ AS (SELECT r.circuitId AS circuitId, c.country AS country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), base AS (SELECT circuitId, country, avg_round, AVG(avg_round) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS baseline FROM circ) SELECT circuitId, country, avg_round, avg_round - baseline AS diff FROM base ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
